current_date: Autumn 2022 ('These requirements were reviewed and readopted Autumn 2022')
current_evidence: The live 'List of documents required by GBC LPA' page states 'These requirements were reviewed and readopted Autumn 2022', and searches of gosport.gov.uk found no newer local list or separate checklist document.

issues.detail: The whole 'Supporting documents and thresholds' table is missing from Grokbot's capture. The missing requirements are: (1) Affordable Housing Statement / Viability Assessment: full/outline, residential 10+ dwellings. (2) Biodiversity Checklist or Survey: all full, outline and householder applications. (3) Contamination Assessment: full/outline, within 250 m of landfill, previous contaminating uses, or known contamination. (4) Flood Risk Assessment: full/outline in Flood Zones 2/3, over 1 ha in FZ1, or flagged in the SFRA as future flood risk. (5) Heritage Statement: full, outline, householder and LBC affecting heritage assets. (6) Lighting Assessment: full/outline, majors only. (7) Noise Impact Assessment: full/outline for noise-generating or noise-sensitive uses. (8) Retail Impact Assessment: retail over 1,000 sqm. (9) Impact Assessment: office/leisure over 2,500 sqm. (10) Transport Assessment and (Draft) Travel Plan: thresholds such as C3 80 dwellings, B1 2,500 sqm, A1 food 800 sqm. (11) Transport Statement: thresholds such as C3 50 dwellings, A1 food 250 sqm. (12) Tree Survey / AIA: full/outline and works to protected trees, where trees may be lost or affected. (13) Ventilation/Extraction (Impact) Report: full, and RM for siting/appearance/layout, for A3/A4/A5/B1/B2 uses.
issues.evidence: Gosport page table 'Document | Required for | Threshold' listing Affordable Housing Statement ... Ventilation/Extraction (Impact) Report

issues.detail: Some local plan-content requirements are not captured as rows. Roof plans are needed for any roof created or altered. Block plan must be at 1:200/1:500 with boundary treatments. Neighbouring elevations are needed unless buildings are more than 30 m apart. Site location plan must show two named roads and an OS licence number.
issues.evidence: Plans section: 'Roof plans: required for any roof created or altered'; elevations 'Neighbouring elevations are required unless buildings are more than 30 m apart'

issues.detail: List date and Date basis are blank and 'Outdated (>2y)?' says 'Undated', but the page gives a date: Autumn 2022. As of November 2026 that is more than 2 years old, so the flag should be 'Yes'.
issues.evidence: "These requirements were reviewed and readopted Autumn 2022."

issues.detail: The Flood Risk Assessment row gives the Fire Statement trigger ('any planning application for a development comprising two or more dwellings or educational accommodation in a building that would exceed either seven storeys or 18 metres...'), not the flood trigger. The real FRA trigger is Flood Zones 2/3, sites over 1 ha in Flood Zone 1, or SFRA future-risk areas, for full and outline applications.
issues.evidence: FRA table row: 'Flood Zones 2 and 3; sites over 1 ha in Flood Zone 1; sites flagged in the SFRA as future flood risk'

issues.detail: Other triggers are fragments. Design and Access Statement merges the D&A, FRA and Fire Statement sentences. Environmental Statement and Habitats Regulations rows are both the same fragment ('...and an Appropriate Assessment, will be required to be submitted with applications where necessary'). Street scene row starts mid-sentence ('developments, wider street scenes...') and drops the scope, which is Major and Minor developments. Advertisement row is just 'colours of illumination must be shown.'
issues.evidence: Elevations section: 'Street scenes may be needed for Major and Minor developments'

issues.detail: Several app types are marked '(none) - national requirements only' although the list applies local requirements to them. Listed building consent needs a Heritage Statement. Works to trees needs a Tree Survey/AIA for works to protected trees. Reserved matters needs a Ventilation/Extraction report (siting, appearance, layout) and a Nitrogen Budget where overnight accommodation is created. Outline needs Affordable Housing, Biodiversity, Contamination, FRA, Heritage, Transport, Tree and Noise items, plus CIL. Advertisement consent needs the advertisement details (lettering, materials, colours, projection, illumination), which Grokbot put under Full planning instead.
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement 'Full, outline and householder applications; Listed Building Consent'; Tree Survey 'Full and outline applications; works to protected trees'; Ventilation 'Full applications; reserved matters for siting, appearance and layout'

issues.detail: Most captured rows (about 8) are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' with no check of the source. Examples are Advertisement drawings, Design and Access Statement, Environmental Statement, Site levels, FRA, HRA, Pre-application advice and Street scene. CIL is placed only under Householder and Full, but the source says the form applies to 'all planning applications (including householder)' creating over 100 sqm or any new dwelling, so outline, RM and s73 are left out.
issues.evidence: CIL: 'must be submitted with all planning applications (including householder) that relate to either the erection of more than 100 square metres of new floorspace or any number of new dwellings'

issues.detail: The 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' row is website navigation menu text, not a requirement ('Planning Permission Pre-application advice Public Access - Terms and Conditions Development Management Officers contact details Hampshire Minerals and Waste Plan ...').
issues.evidence: app_type_rows Full planning: Pre-application advice / engagement details

issues.detail: Some tab items are submission-format and process text rather than document requirements: the CD/storage device for paper Major/Minor applications, and the single paper copy for electronic Majors. The nutrient neutrality follow-on sentence ('If this information is not submitted with the application it will still be required...') is explanation of the Nitrogen Budget requirement, not a separate item.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' and second 'Policy-driven requirements' item

issues.detail: The Nutrient Neutrality (Nitrogen Budget) requirement is captured only in the tab and appears in no application-type row. The source applies it to applications for new residential or other overnight accommodation, which would include full, outline, RM and change of use.
issues.evidence: "Applications for new residential or other overnight accommodation should be accompanied by Nitrogen Budget calculated in accordance with Natural England guidance"

summary: Grokbot's link is Gosport's current list (readopted Autumn 2022, now more than 2 years old), but the date was not captured. The extraction missed the entire supporting-documents table (13 local requirements with thresholds), gave the FRA row the Fire Statement trigger, and filled other rows with fragments and menu text.
